caribbean.headline: Caribbean Winds Rise
caribbean.paragraph: Turks & Caicos is experiencing 21 kt winds with 4.7 ft wave heights and a 50% rain probability, while Antigua has 17 kt winds, making these ports the most impacted in the Eastern Caribbean today. I expect the strong easterly winds to continue, with the highest waves and greatest rain probability focused on Turks & Caicos.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Conditions: Mykonos
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos in the Eastern Mediterranean is the highest-impact location in the Mediterranean this period, with winds peaking at 24 kt and seas building to 6.8 ft with SW swell at 7s periods. less than 10% rain probability -- overall conditions are favorable for cruise operations.
